agents.description: Recommends controlled vocabularies, ontologies and data formats from FAIRsharing for a dataset profile, grounded on the registry records it retrieved. Ranking rules choose first; a model may add records it found and note doubts, never remove one. Each recommendation is proposed for the researcher to choose in their project.

json_schema.$comment: Generated from standards.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to standards.yaml>`. Do not edit.

CategoryCount.description: One category of a field and how many rows hold it, rounded.
CategoryCount.title: CategoryCount

DisclosureCheck.description: What the disclosure check of a field's summary values did: the rules, their parameters, the tool and how many values it left out, never which (docs/specs/personal-data.md).

check_rounding_base.description: The base counts were rounded to.

check_rules.description: The rules applied, such as minimum threshold, k-th value range, p-ratio, nk dominance, zeros disclosive and rounding.

check_suppressed.description: How many of the field's summary values were left out. Never which.

check_tool.description: The output checker that applied the rules, such as acro.

DisclosureCheck.title: DisclosureCheck

FieldSummary.description: Summary values of one table field that the inventory command computed where the data live and passed through statistical disclosure control before writing (docs/specs/personal-data.md). A value that failed a rule is absent, never altered to pass; every count is at least the check's threshold and rounded to its base, and a range is never the raw minimum and maximum.

summary_categories.description: The field's categories that at least k rows hold, with their counts. Rarer categories are left out and counted in check_suppressed.

summary_mean.description: The mean of a numeric field's values, missing-value codes left out, written only when the threshold and dominance rules pass.

summary_missing_codes.description: Values the field holds that are often used for missing data (-99, -999, 999, 9999, NA, N/A, NaN, null, .), each held by at least k rows, with their counts.

summary_null_count.description: How many of the rows read hold no value in the field, rounded.

summary_range_high.description: The upper bound of the field's values, the k-th largest, as summary_range_low.

summary_range_low.description: The lower bound of the field's values: the k-th smallest, so that at least k rows (the check's threshold) lie at or below it. A number or an ISO 8601 date or time, as text.

summary_rows_read.description: How many rows were read to compute the summaries, rounded.

FieldSummary.title: FieldSummary

MissingCodeCount.description: A value that a field may use for missing data, such as -99 or NA, and how many rows hold it, rounded.
MissingCodeCount.title: MissingCodeCount

TableField.description: One field of a tabular resource, mirroring a Frictionless Table Schema field descriptor. Frictionless publishes no RDF namespace, so these slots carry see_also rather than a slot_uri (TODO(#20): revisit if Frictionless publishes term IRIs).

field_disclosure_check.description: The disclosure check the field's summary values passed. Present whenever field_summary is.

field_summary.description: The field's summary values (docs/specs/personal-data.md). Absent, no summaries were made: by an older command, in a runtime where they do not run, or with them turned off.

field_type.description: Frictionless field type (string, number, integer, boolean, date, datetime, time, duration, geopoint, ...).

TableField.title: TableField

json_schema.description: A minimal description of a dataset being planned or prepared: what it is about and how it is shaped. Every slot maps onto an external vocabulary rather than a Data Director namespace.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

themes.description: Discipline or subject, as free text or an IRI.

json_schema.title: DatasetProfile

json_schema.$comment: Generated from standards.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to standards.yaml>`. Do not edit.

FactKind.description: What a project fact is about (docs/specs/projects.md).
FactKind.title: FactKind

FileDecision.description: Whether a file of the inventory is to be deposited.
FileDecision.title: FileDecision

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

LocationPrecision.description: The precision at which a location may be published.
LocationPrecision.title: LocationPrecision

ProjectFact.description: One fact about a project that a check agent proposes and a person confirms: a funder, a repository a funder or institution requires, whether a file is deposited, whether a sensitive field or file may be published and at what precision, the licence, an output a data management plan committed to share, a standard, vocabulary or format the researcher chose for the dataset, or which attached document is the project's data management plan (docs/specs/projects.md). fact_kind says which of the value slots apply; fact_subject is the key a person's decision counts by, so the last decision on a subject stands. An agent's payload carries proposals in proposed_facts; only a person's decision makes one a fact, and the conductor gives the facts a person decided to every drafter and orchestrator in the project as project_decisions, without proposed_because.

commitment_access.description: For a sharing commitment, how openly the plan committed to share the output (such as open, embargoed or on request), as the plan says it; absent where it says nothing.

commitment_document.description: For a sharing commitment, the digest of the attached document's text (its documentation_digest) the quote is from.

commitment_licence.description: For a sharing commitment, the licence the plan committed to, as the plan names it; absent where it names none.

commitment_quote.description: For a sharing commitment, the plan's own words the commitment was read from, verbatim, so the person deciding can see the passage it rests on.

commitment_repository.description: For a sharing commitment, the repository the plan committed to share the output in, as the plan names it; absent where it names none. A plan that names several for one output gives a sharing commitment for each.

fact_check_kind.description: The kind of check that raised the fact, in the checking agent's words, such as duplicate, system_file or third_party. Kept as it was given; the core does not enumerate it.

fact_crossref_funder_id.description: The funder's Crossref Funder ID, as a DOI URL, where it is known.

fact_file_path.description: The path of the file the fact is about, relative to the dataset's root folder, as the inventory gives it.

fact_funder_name.description: The funder's name, as its policy record or the researcher gives it.

fact_funder_ror.description: The funder's ROR identifier, as a URL, where it is known.

fact_kind.description: What the fact is about, which says which value slots apply.

fact_re3data_id.description: The required repository's re3data identifier, such as r3d100010199, where known.

fact_required_by.description: The funders, journals or institutions that require the repository.

fact_subject.description: The key a decision counts by within its kind: the funder's identifier or name, the repository's re3data identifier or name, the file's path, the field or path judged sensitive, licence, or the standard chosen and what it is chosen for. The last decision on a kind and subject stands.

file_decision.description: Whether the file is to be deposited.

licence_id.description: The licence decided, as an SPDX identifier or a URL.

location_precision.description: For a location that may be published or generalised, the precision agreed. Absent where the subject is not a location.

plan_document.description: For a data management plan fact, the digest of the attached document's text (its documentation_digest) that is the project's plan.

proposed_because.description: Why the agent proposes the fact, in a sentence for the person deciding. Kept with the proposal and shown to the person, never given to an agent.

sensitive_subject.description: The field name, or the file path, judged sensitive, such as a lat or lon field, or a file of site coordinates.

sensitivity_decision.description: Whether the sensitive field or file may be published, and how.

standard_id.description: For a standard fact, a persistent identifier of the standard, as a URL, such as its FAIRsharing DOI, where it is known.

standard_kind.description: For a standard fact, what kind of standard was chosen, where it is known.

standard_name.description: For a standard fact, the name of the standard, vocabulary, ontology or format chosen, as its registry record or the researcher gives it.

standard_target.description: For a standard fact, what the standard is chosen for: dataset, or field:<name> for one field of the dataset's tables. Absent means the dataset.

ProjectFact.title: ProjectFact

Recommendation.description: One recommended resource for one target. The resource is named only in grounded_on; its name, status and DOI are in the cited evidence item's content (docs/specs/grounding.md).

concern.description: A model's doubt that a record the rules chose suits the dataset. The recommendation is kept; a person decides.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

notes.description: Facts to weigh beside the recommendation, such as that a model chose it.

selection_derivation.description: Who chose the record: lexical, by the ranking rules over the first search, or model, by a model from the records retrieved in the run, its own searches included.

target.description: dataset, or field:<name> for a field-level recommendation.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation

SearchedSummary.description: What was looked for, so a reader can judge an abstention as well as a recommendation.

snapshot_ref.description: Which copy of the registry answered, e.g. snapshot:2026-09-04 or live.

SearchedSummary.title: SearchedSummary

SensitivityDecision.description: Whether a sensitive field or file may be published.
SensitivityDecision.title: SensitivityDecision

StandardKind.description: What kind of standard a standard fact names.
StandardKind.title: StandardKind

json_schema.description: The standards advisor payload. Recommended vocabularies, ontologies and formats, each also proposed as a standard project fact for the researcher to choose or reject (docs/specs/projects.md).

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

limitations.description: What the advisor does not yet do.

proposed_facts.description: Facts the agent proposes for a person to confirm. A proposal is never a fact until a person decides it (docs/specs/projects.md).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

json_schema.title: Recommendations
